description: Fetch the full public profile for a single MentorCruise mentor. Use the `username` from a search_mentors result. Returns name, headline, company, bio, skills, languages, rating, monthly price, response time, open spots, and the public profile URL. Returns {'error': 'not_found'} if the mentor doesn't exist or is hidden.
name: get_mentor_profile

outputSchema.description: Return shape of get_mentor_profile (a full public profile).

does_calls.description: Whether the mentor offers video calls.
does_calls.title: Does Calls

error.description: Error code: 'not_found' or 'rate_limit_exceeded'. Absent on success.
error.title: Error

lowest_price_usd.description: Cheapest offering in USD (subscription or one-off).
lowest_price_usd.title: Lowest Price Usd

open_to_inquiries.description: Whether the mentor accepts free inquiries.
open_to_inquiries.title: Open To Inquiries

profile_image_url.description: Absolute URL to the profile image.
profile_image_url.title: Profile Image Url

profile_url.description: Absolute URL to the public profile.
profile_url.title: Profile Url

rating.description: Average review rating (0-5), or null if unrated.
rating.title: Rating

response_time_hours.description: Median response time in hours; may be fractional.
response_time_hours.title: Response Time Hours

outputSchema.title: MentorProfileResponse
